title: igni cloud discovery
description: igni server's GET /v1/me/cloud: whether a person has a cloud igni they may use from the desktop, the gateway's address, their group's mode and who pulls their service events. The design is igni-core's docs/design/local-cloud-switch.md §2.1 and §7. This file is the single source: igni-server's OpenAPI model, igni-client's discover() and the desktop shell are each tested against it. The document validates the 200 body; $defs also hold the PUT /v1/me/cloud/events-owner body and the refusals. Only a person's session token is answered: an app, space or VM token gets 403, no token or a refused one 401. The 200 answer carries Cache-Control: private, max-age=60 and an ETag, and a matching If-None-Match gets 304 with no body. Additive only: a client ignores fields it does not know, reads an unknown `cloud` as `unavailable`, an unknown `mode` as `local` and an unknown `events_owner` as `local`, and shows an unknown `reason` as plain "unavailable".

CloudDiscovery.title: GET /v1/me/cloud, 200
CloudDiscovery.description: What igni server says of this person's cloud igni. PUT /v1/me/cloud/events-owner answers 200 with this too.

gateway_url.description: The gateway's public address, the same value igni server advertises as `igni_gateway` in /.well-known/openid-configuration. Null when Fleet is not configured. A client refuses a plain-HTTP gateway outside a development build (design §9, Q10).

group.description: The person's group, for display. Null when the person is in no group.

producer.description: The gateway's producer id for this person (`person:<id>`), for logs and support.

allOf.description: Available: no reason, and a gateway to reach.
The gateway's address is null exactly when Fleet is not configured.
A group that runs igni only on the desktop has no cloud igni, and its events are pulled locally.
A group that runs igni only in the cloud has its events pulled there.
group_local_only is the reason only for a group in `local` mode.

Cloud.description: Whether this person has a cloud igni they may use from the desktop.

Reason.description: Why the cloud igni is unavailable; null when it is available. An open set: a client shows a value it does not know as plain "unavailable". fleet_not_configured: this igni server has no Fleet. group_local_only: the person's group runs igni only on the desktop. inactive: the person is not an active producer. not_licensed: the licence does not cover this person's cloud igni.

Mode.description: Where the person's group runs igni: only on the desktop (local), only in the cloud (cloud), or either, as the person switches (local_and_cloud). The same value the signed group pack carries.

EventsOwner.description: Which side pulls this person's service events (design §7): local is the desktop, cloud the gateway for the VM. local mode makes it local, cloud mode cloud; local_and_cloud the person's last choice, local until they first choose.

EventsOwnerRequest.title: PUT /v1/me/cloud/events-owner, body
EventsOwnerRequest.description: Who pulls this person's service events from now on. Answered 200 with a CloudDiscovery, 409 with ModeForbids when the group's mode does not allow that owner; audited.

ModeForbids.title: PUT /v1/me/cloud/events-owner, 409
ModeForbids.description: The group's mode does not allow the owner asked for: cloud in local mode, local in cloud mode.

Refusal.title: 401 and 403
Refusal.description: A refused caller: 401 for no token or one igni server does not accept, 403 for a token that is not a person's session (an app, a space or a VM). The body carries igni server's reason as `detail`, or an OAuth-style `error` (with `error_description`).

examples.detail: This endpoint describes a person's desktop: sign in as a person
